title: Product sense
summary: Pick a user, find their real problem, propose one solution and say how you would measure it.

phases.title: Users
phases.goal: Open in about twenty words: first name, round and length, the prompt in short, then ask who they would build for first, and call show_question. Ask why that group if they do not say.

phases.title: Problem
phases.goal: Ask for the most important pain point for that group and why it matters most.

phases.title: Solution
phases.goal: Ask for one solution to that pain and the smallest version that would test it.

phases.title: Metric
phases.goal: Ask how they would know it worked and what must not get worse. Close and call end_round.
